messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Government and Legal Affairs" as it appears in the following examples.
['I will advise you to contact my private Attorney Barr. James Broderick base in the United Kingdom on his contact stated below for onward proceedings:', 'I AM HEREBY WRITING TO INFORM YOU THAT THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT OF BENIN IS KEEN AND VERY DETERMINED TO PAY YOUR OVERDUE DEBTS, THIS IS NOT A FLUKE, I WOULD NOT WANT YOU TO Lose THIS FUND OUT OF IGNORANCE AND THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT OF BENIN HAS this afternoon deposit your inheritance $6.5 Million United States dollars with United Bank For Africa.', 'You will receive these funds under legal claims; all legal documents will be carefully worked out to ensure a risky free transfer.', "the present government of Côte d'Ivoire has revoked the passport of all officers who served under the former regime and now asked country to expel such persons at the same time freeze their account and confiscate their assets", 'After the last annual calculation of your fiscal activity we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 244.79 GBP', 'then I will proceed by Sending a POWER of ATTORNEY to him and a release letter that will direct the DiplomaticSecurity Company to deliver the funds to you either by cash or by BankTransfer due to the fact that the funds are deposited in cash.', 'I have all necessary legal documents that can be used to Back up any claim will be obtained From the Court of England with the Certificate Of Deposit which has been issued to me by the Bank.', 'I am an attorney at law.', 'Information on Overdraft Court Baseplates Update : 28 May 2010 OFT announcement and decision of the Supreme Court (formerly House of Lords)', 'INTUIT INC. has taken part in the Internal Revenue Service [IRS] Name and TIN Matching Program.', 'My son is still under detention arraigned before the federal high court of Nigeria for an offense he did not commit.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
